messages:
Alex G: Morning — quick async standup.
- Yesterday: locked down routing rollout plan and landed the canary config.
- Blocker: infra quota still pending (CN region), seeing a small perf regression in the v2 routing path (~5-7% p99 increase).
- Today: open PR for the release (needs 1 reviewer + perf sanity), update the spec with fallback routing table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/451

Maria P: I can take the PR review after 10am PT. Quick question — do we need a schema change for the new fallback?

Alex G: Good, thanks. The plan is to keep the request schema the same and add an optional `routing_fallback` field in the config only. No consumer-visible API change.

Samir: pinging @Maria P and @Chen L — codeowners set on that dir. I'll queue a review with perf checklist. Also can we add a small test harness to reproduce the p99 bump?

Chen L: Quota update: infra requested justification this morning, should be approved in ~3–4 hours. For the perf bump, initial guess is the new kernel selection falling back to generic path for short contexts. If that's it, we can force the optimized kernel via config: `kernel_policy: prefer_optimized` and retest.

Maria P: sounds good. Add a short note in the PR description to show forcing `kernel_policy` results and we can include that in the rollback criteria.

Alex G: Will do. Quick spec snippet (copy into the spec doc):
```yaml
routing:
  fallback: true
  fallback_policy: least_cost
  kernel_policy: prefer_optimized
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-status] Canary deploy started for `v2-routing` on cluster-prod-canary — 3/5 nodes healthy.

Alex G: Thanks bot. If canary is green, plan to ship in this window. If we hit p99 > target we rollback.

Samir: I'll run the perf harness once deploy-bot shows stable. If anyone wants, I can post the harness command here.

Maria P: Reviewing now — left one nit inline. Should be quick. :thumbsup:

Chen L: FYI I added a temporary autoscale rule to reduce tail latency risk during the canary: `min_replicas:2` for canary pool.

Alex G: Nice, thanks. Anyone blocking signoff?

Maria P: none from me after PR changes.

Samir: none from me — I'll finish the perf run and report back by EOD.

Alex G: Great — thanks team. I'll mark the rollout plan as "in-flight" in the ops doc and update the spec link: https://docs.internal.redwood/inference/v2-routing-spec#fallback

Alex G: (closing note) If canary fails, revert with: `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>` and notify #incidents.
